# Fetch all albums from the library to find one released in 2021
access_token = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2FsZXhhbmRlci1yaWRkQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.YRyVkOEbOgKsiE9ffQrAfLyugMrq11hmtx_dAepHEYQ"
page_index = 0
all_albums = []
while True:
    response = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    albums = response.get("albums", [])
    if not albums:
        break
    all_albums.extend(albums)
    if len(albums) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Find an album released in 2021

for album in all_albums:
    release_date = album.get("release_date", "")

        target_album = album
        break

print("Target album:", target_album)
